notes.title: STEAMWORLD BUILD PHYSICAL RELEASE 🔥🔥🔥
notes.notes:
[h3]OPEN YOUR MINES AND GET READY TO EXPLORE! [/h3]

We're excited to share that we've teamed up with Super Rare Games to launch an exclusive physical edition of SteamWorld Build 🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43532776/802c59e26e49ce27dd91a069c353d33d657e9f15.jpg[/img]

SteamWorld Build is a casual city-building and dungeon-management cross-over set in the SteamWorld Universe, where you build and manage a town on a dying planet. You'll need to balance resources, construction, and exploration to its depths to ensure your town's survival and eventual escape! 

[h3]Launching January 9th at 6pm GMT / 10am PST on PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch. [/h3]

Copies will be limited to 2000 on PlayStation 5 and 4000 on Nintendo Switch. 

Don't miss your chance! 

Bookmark the Super Rare Games [url=https://superraregames.com/collections/srg-store-new-web]website[/url] now and prepare to build, Steam-mates.

notes.title: Steam Fright Update: Welcome to the Spooky Side of SteamWorld Build! 🎃
notes.notes:

[previewyoutube=NzUlhd983TY;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]🔦 What’s New:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New Night Map:[/b] Navigate through the darkness and build your empire in spooky style!
[*] [b]11 Placeable Decorations:[/b] Customise your town with a Spooky Tree, Pumpkin Patch, Tesla Coil, Mausoleum, Ghost Volleyball court, and more!
[*] [b]8 Environmental Decorations:[/b] From flying ghosts to glowing pumpkins, watch as your town transforms into a haunted haven.
[*] [b]New Glowing Spooky Train:[/b] Watch it light up the night in creepy fashion!

notes.title: Summer's here - and so is a sizzling SteamWorld Build update! ☀️
notes.notes:
SteamWorld Build's latest update brings sunshine, sausages, sandcastles, and a touch of Swedish Midsommar magic to your desert town.

[previewyoutube=3dJDeATS6Vw;full][/previewyoutube]
Celebrate the summer solstice with:

😎 [b]11 New Player Decorations:[/b] Add a splash of summer to your town with a pool, sandcastle, sunflowers, strawberries, a tent, and more!

😎 [b]Robots Get Festive:[/b] Watch your bots bounce in a bouncy castle, sizzle sausages at a fire pit, chill out on beach chairs, and dance around a midsummer pole singing the traditional "små grodorna" song!

😎 [b]New Environmental Decorations: [/b]Spruce up your world with birch trees, sandcastles, sunflowers and beach chairs. 

😎 [b]Butterflies & Blooms:[/b] Look out for our new "shark bath ball" tumbleweeds and enjoy a world teeming with beautiful butterflies - all under a special shader!

😎 [b]Dressing Up for the Festivities:[/b] Your Agents will be equipped with festive hats featuring midsommar wreaths, flower crowns and even a sand bucket!

😎 [b]Hoppy Helpers:[/b] Watch adorable little frogs hopping around your town, adding to the joyful atmosphere!

notes.title: Post-Launch Hot Patch - PC, PlayStation and Xbox.
notes.notes:
[h3]We're pleased to share that a patch is now live for Steam / GOG / EPIC as well as PS4 / PS5 and Xbox [/h3]

We will keep you updated with the progress on the Nintendo Switch patch. 

[b]HOT FIX UPDATES: [/b]

[list][*] Added accessibility option for changing the scale of standard tooltips.[/list][LIST][*] Added accessibility option for changing the scale of the construction tooltip that appears when constructing buildings, roads, rooms, etc.[/list][list][*] Added accessibility option for offsetting the position of the construction tooltip that appears when constructing buildings, roads, rooms, etc.[/list][list]
[*] Added accessibility option for changing the transparency of the construction tooltip that appears when constructing buildings, roads, rooms, etc.[/list][list]
[*] Added accessibility option for changing the scale of the bottom left information windows.[/list][list][*] Added accessibility option for changing the scale of the tooltips that appear when hovering the panels in the top-screen UI bar.[/list][list][*] Added accessibility option for disabling screen shakes.[/list][list]
[*] Holding down the buttons to add/remove resources in the trade window will add/remove resources at a faster rate the longer the buttons are held down to avoid having to spam click.[/list][list]
[*] The right hand side scroll-list of resources to buy in the trade window will now also show red/green arrows to indicate the production status just like the left-hand side.[/list][list][*] Added feedback to the miners section in the top-screen UI bar by making the background red if not all supported miners of a specific miner type can be recruited because the max miner global cap has already been reached.[/list][list][*] When playing in sandbox mode the camera will be focused on the main mineshaft the first time you enter each mine floor instead of the secondary leading down.[/list][list][*] Removed Playfab and updated EULA.[/list]

As always, we appreciate your feedback and your patience.  

If you experience any issues, please reach out to us either on Steam or complete a bug report in [url=https://discord.gg/rTfGBdMGfm]our Discord server.[/url] 

Happy Building!

notes.title: EULA Policy Update
notes.notes:
Hi SteamWorld Build players! 

We have an important update on our EULA and our use of third-party tools that we have been working on since launch. 

Some of you rightly raised concerns when you read our original EULA and looked at our use of data collection tools. We have moved as quickly as we can to address this and are happy to finally be able to give you the update you deserved. 

As this involved some legal discussions we couldn’t be as open as we normally would want when we are updating our games based on player feedback. But now we have an update almost in place we can give you the complete picture. 

For complete clarity we are working hard on a Hot Patch that we are aiming to get out as soon as possible, ideally next week. The below Q&A on an update is speaking to that, but if something delays this our community team will let you know.

[h3]What is an EULA and why do I have to agree to it?[/h3]

The EULA is a legal agreement granting the player a licence to be able to play SteamWorld Build. This is standard practice across the games industry.

[h3]What is the third party tool referenced in the EULA?[/h3]

This is a tool called PlayFab, an industry tool offered by Microsoft and run on Azure to collect player data safely and securely.

As Thunderful is an independent publisher we made the decision to utilise a fully GDPR compliant, highly secure existing industry tool rather than attempting to build our own to store player data. All data collected was for the sole purpose of improving the game and player experience.

We are removing the paragraph titled Third-Party Tools in the EULA because we are removing the third-party tool from the game with next week's Hot Patch.

[h3]Why are you removing the tool?[/h3]

When the community raised concerns on the way our EULA had been written we started investigating how we had integrated PlayFab into SteamWorld Build. We discovered that although we had remained fully GDPR compliant, our wording in the EULA was misleading (we would never sell on player data or work with people who do or work with anyone who would put player data at risk), and our way of integrating the tool could have been better from a player point of view. Therefore we looked closely at the best way to move forward; create an opt-out, or disconnect PlayFab entirely. We realised if we attempted to add the opt-out we actually put our own development patch schedule at risk. So the decision was made in the best interest of our players, removing the integration altogether and updating our EULA to avoid any more confusion.

[h3]What data did you collect?[/h3]

Players who play the game from launch through to our Hot Patch next week have had anonymised data collected per play session, not per player. Each session data set showed us what the anonymous player had done in that session in game. 

We didn’t collect anything associated with the player e.g. Usernames, emails etc

[h3]Can I have any data collected on me removed?[/h3]

We are looking into this and will update when we can. Our first step is to look at how we can make sure a player can access any data on PlayFab.Then we will provide an update which shows how this can be done. 

This is a high priority for us.

UPDATE 21/12/2023: After a thorough investigation, as we initially thought the data is anonymised to the point a player couldn't put in an individual request to have any data associated with them removed. Therefore, as a show of good faith, we are working to delete all the data and we apologise for any upset this may have caused you. 

[h3]Will you use PlayFab or any other data collecting tool in the future?[/h3]

Yes. This was an initial test to help us improve how we can bring games to players. It didn’t work as intended and the way our EULA was written understandably upset some players. 

We are always looking for ways to improve how we use data to make the playing experience better. Moving forward we will always provide an opt-out to players for Third Party data collecting tools.

Microsoft Azure’s PlayFab is a great tool, for both developers and players.

[h3]Why did Thunderful do this?[/h3]

At Thunderful we pride ourselves on being a truly player first games developer and publisher. All decisions are made with you, our loyal playing community in mind. From what tools we want to use to make our games better, through to how we respond to issues when they are raised to us by you.

This was a big lesson for us, we’ve taken it all onboard and thank the community for letting us know what is and isn’t acceptable. Please carry on keeping us on our toes and we’ll continue being open with you.

Keep on building!
Everyone at Thunderful

notes.title: SteamWorld Build set for a 2023 release and there's a demo available now
notes.notes:
Thunderful and The Station have announced that SteamWorld is back via a new entry in the beloved franchise titled SteamWorld Build.

The game takes a well known genre and gives it a unique twist, with a multi-level city-building experience that tasks you with constructing a thriving town above ground, while mining resources and dealing with monsters below.

In the game, you are the architect of a mining town. Your job is to break ground and raise houses for your steambot citizens, keep them fed and provide entertainment. You’ll also venture into the abandoned mine sitting under your town, and it's rumored to be filled with ancient tech that holds the key to escaping impending doom.
